texts.zh: 我们自[space_slavers_country.GetName][GetPreFTLUpperPlural]收到了令人动摇的报告：肆无忌惮的奴隶贩子伪装成商人，正在滥用我们的贸易协定，降落到该星球上大肆绑架当地人。当一大批[space_slavers_species.GetName][GetPreFTLUpperPlural]出现在某个地下奴隶贸易市场上的时候，我们才了解到这一行径。
texts.en: Disturbing reports from the [space_slavers_country.GetName] [GetPreFTLUpperPlural]: posing as merchants, unscrupulous slavers have been abusing our Trade Deal to land on the planet and abduct the local population. We only learned of the practice when a large group of [space_slavers_species.GetName] [GetPreFTLUpperPlural] was listed on an off-grid slave market.

label.zh: 如果他们想要我们的奴隶，那就得交税。
label.en: If they want our slaves, there's a tax!
